summary: Frontend-only testing completed for unit conversion bug fix in emission calculations. All 6 features verified working correctly: unit conversions are mathematically correct (g, kg, tonne), 1000g equals 1kg in calculations, 1 tonne equals 1000kg in calculations, Admin can see calculation details with applied conversion factor, CO2 formula execution working correctly, and Category → Fuel two-step selection working.

issues: Console hydration warning: <span> inside <select>/<option> - non-blocking, persists from previous iterations

unit_conversion_mathematically_correct.details: getConversionFactor() function correctly returns 1/multiplier. For grams: multiplier=1000 → conversionFactor=0.001. For tonnes: multiplier=0.001 → conversionFactor=1000. Verified via UI testing and API inspection.

1000g_equals_1kg.details: 1000g calculation produces same CO2 emissions as 1kg calculation. Both resulted in 3186300.00 kg CO2 emissions. UI shows: '1000 g × 0.001 = 1 kg'.

1_tonne_equals_1000kg.details: 1 tonne calculation produces same CO2 emissions as 1000kg calculation. Both resulted in 3186300000.00 kg CO2 emissions. UI shows: '1 tonne × 1000 = 1000 kg'.

admin_sees_conversion_details.details: Admin View shows 'Calculation Details (Admin View) - Using Super Admin Formulas' section with 'Unit Conversion Applied (from Super Admin Parameters)' displaying raw quantity, conversion factor, and converted quantity.

co2_formula_execution.details: CO2 formula executes correctly using Super Admin defined formula: 'Quantity of Fuel × Net Calorific value × CO2 emission factor on basis of heat × Density'. Formula steps are shown in Admin View with intermediate calculations.

category_fuel_two_step_selection.details: Add Emission form has Step 1: Select Category dropdown (Mobile Combustion, Stationary Combustion). Step 2: Select Fuel Type dropdown is disabled until category is selected, then shows filtered fuels (e.g., Test Diesel (Global)).

formula_execution_verified.co2_formula: Quantity of Fuel × Net Calorific value × CO2 emission factor on basis of heat × Density
formula_execution_verified.ch4_formula: Quantity of Fuel × Net Calorific value × CH4 emission factor on basis of heat × Density

bug_fix_verification.original_bug: Unit conversions were being multiplied directly by the multiplier value instead of dividing by it
bug_fix_verification.fix_applied: getConversionFactor() now returns 1/multiplier instead of multiplier
bug_fix_verification.verification_result: PASSED - all unit conversions now produce mathematically correct results
